messages:
Oncall-Bot: Pager: KV cache miss ratio spike + continuous-batching backlog > 95th pct for 12m. Impact: increased token latency and retry amplification. Alert: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/kv-cache-cascade - paging eng-oncall :rotating_light:
Alex R.: seeing the alert, joining. initial ask: is this from a sudden prefix growth or batching policy change?
Priya S.: saw a small config rollout ~30m ago to increase max_batch_size to 1024 on canary. might be related.
Jin L.: i pulled the canary diff:
```
service: continuous-batcher
max_batch_size: 1024  # was 512
batch_timeout_ms: 8
kv_cache_eviction_threshold: 0.75  # untouched
```
Mike T.: hm higher max_batch_size increases request coalescing, but we saw KV cache keyset blow up yesterday. if evictions lag, prefix fanout balloons.
Alex R.: rolling back the canary now for canary group -> 512. doing a staged rollback via deploy-bot.
Eng-Runtime: noted. also recommending HPA probe tweak: increase cpu/grpc target to avoid scale-down during warmup. autoscaler is oscillating.
Priya S.: quick customer-impact note: prod traces show ~3% of requests hit 2x latency tail and ~0.4% of requests retried. support ticket volume low but slow. tagging support.
Support-Bot: Created ticket #INC-1412 with initial summary and affected customers list.
Jin L.: rollback triggered, canary rollback in progress — deploy-id: d-2026-04-01-7234.
Alex R.: while rollback finishes, we should mitigate autoscale thrash: adjusting HPA minReplicas from 3 -> 5 for affected pool and bump stabilizationWindow from 60s -> 240s. applying now.
```bash
kubectl -n inference patch hpa continuous-batcher-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":5,"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":240}}}}'
```
Mike T.: applied. monitoring. also lowering max_batch_size globally is heavier lift; prefer rollback + temporary HPA tweak.
Priya S.: observed KV cache growth rate dropping after rollback start, but still elevated — evictions lagging. eviction queue size: 18k keys. we should run a targeted eviction job to shed hot-prefixes.
Jin L.: launching eviction job (ttl-based trim + aggressive LRU sweep) against pool `cb-prod-a`. job: evict-run-17688.
Eng-Runtime: recommend also temporarily reducing batch_timeout_ms -> 4ms to favor latency over throughput while warmup completes. propose: patch config map continuous-batcher-config -> batch_timeout_ms: 4
Alex R.: doing the config patch in staging then prod via feature-flag rollout.
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: continuous-batcher-config
data:
  batch_timeout_ms: "4"
```
Mike T.: eviction job started. I'm watching mem + kv-cache hit ratio.
Priya S.: customer impact update: tail latencies trending down from +120% to +30% over 10m. no new retries after eviction job start.
Oncall-Bot: Incident timeline note created in #incidents with link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/1768802001
Alex R.: After rollback and HPA stabilization, autoscaler didn't oscillate for two cooldown cycles. will keep minReplicas=5 until eviction queue < 2k and kv-hit > 0.9.
Jin L.: eviction job finished. removed ~14k keys, some hot-prefix consolidation observed.
Mike T.: after eviction and reduced timeout, 95th latency back to baseline for most routes; a couple long-tail customers still at ~1.4x. tracing points to legacy routing hitting smaller legacy model variant. filed followup to migrate to the newer variant with better kv locality.
Priya S.: drafting customer outbound: brief summary, mitigation actions, ETA for full normalization (~2h). adding impacted customer list from Support-Bot.
Support-Bot: linked ticket #INC-1412 to customer emails and internal RCA doc (placeholder).
Alex R.: plan for next steps: 1) keep minReplicas=5 + stab window 240s for 2h, 2) run a KV compaction sweep in low-traffic window, 3) revert max_batch_size increase in canary config permanently until we have kv eviction improvements, 4) follow up with model-routing team.
Eng-Runtime: will own the compaction sweep and coordinate with infra for a maintenance window.
Jin L.: logging the immediate postmortem items: "avoid large single-diff batch size increases without cache-probing rollout", "HPA thresholds should be reviewed when batch configs change", "auto-eviction circuit breaker for prefix amplification".
Alex R.: handing off to overnight oncall: Priya, you'll be the owner for stabilization monitoring and customer comms. please escalate to eng-runtime if eviction queue > 5k or 95th latency > 1.5x baseline.
Priya S.: ack handoff. will monitor the dashboard, set alerts for eviction-queue and tail latency, and update ticket.
Support-Bot: Note: customer notifications queued, will send after review.
Oncall-Bot: Thread closed when metrics reached recovery thresholds, but followups remain.
